sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about Luke 2:16 (the shepherds hurrying off) before any story card has told that verse. Story card 13 tells verse 16 only afterward, so the choice runs ahead of the passage and has no setup.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: The card says Mary is "right there in the middle of all this." Luke 2:16-19 never places Mary among the people who heard the shepherds. It says only that she treasured and pondered these things, so the card adds a setting the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
